# LaplandActivities

> Snowmobile safaris, husky sledding, aurora hunts, smoke saunas. Book hand-picked Lapland activities through trusted operators across Rovaniemi, Levi, Saariselkä and beyond.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandactivities.fi/): Aurora, husky and snowmobile tours in Lapland by destination and category
- [Destinations](https://laplandactivities.fi/destinations): Lapland activity destinations: Rovaniemi, Levi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Inari, Ruka and more
- [Categories](https://laplandactivities.fi/categories): Activities by category: adventure, animals, northern lights, winter sports, wellness, culture
- [Fishing](https://laplandactivities.fi/fishing): Ice fishing, licensed salmon rivers like the Tornio, and king-crab safaris with permit links
- [Bear Kuusamo](https://laplandactivities.fi/bear-kuusamo): Guided hides for watching wild brown bears in the border forests of Kuusamo
- [Rovaniemi](https://laplandactivities.fi/destinations/rovaniemi): Activities in Rovaniemi
- [Levi](https://laplandactivities.fi/destinations/levi): Activities in Levi
- [Northern lights](https://laplandactivities.fi/categories/northern-lights): Northern-lights tours and experiences
- [About](https://laplandactivities.fi/about): About LaplandActivities

## Languages
